content: {"phoneNote":"The two text-link CTAs float in a dead band and the hero photo only half enters the first screen, pushed to the bottom-right corner.","desktopNote":"The hero works with the arched photo and 'Tina' watermark, but the four-line headline is oversized and the primary action is a thin underlined link that gets lost under it.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":4,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Replace the small arch photo in 'Kdo vas počesa' (it is the hero photo again) with a portrait of Tina or a different hairstyle shot.","Make 'Naročite se' a solid green button and on phone pull the photo up directly under it to remove the empty band; on desktop reduce the headline to three lines.","Add the hour axis labels to the phone opening-hours chart so the bars read as a timeline, as on desktop."],"blockers":["Phone and desktop, 'Kdo vas počesa' section: the wavy-hair photo from the hero is repeated as the second overlapping arch."]}
